exclusions.note: Top-ups only roll the balance. Whether a top-up is recorded in Money Forward depends on your own funding chain — decide this yourself and write the rule here.
Example only: a top-up from this wallet to another wallet that Money Forward already syncs would double count if recorded as spending.

reconciliation.anchor: Money Forward balance at the end of the previous month
reconciliation.note: Roll the balance forward from the anchor with charges and payments, then compare with the wallet app's real balance before entering.
